notes: New: Radio's Previous/Next station and seek controls can now be turned on or off separately for the mini player, the Now Playing screen, and the notification, with a choice of Seek, Previous/Next, or Both, and a 5-55 second seek duration when Seek is on. Improved: Auto EQ no longer flickers on borderline content - it now recognizes music with vocals as music instead of occasionally misreading it as plain speech, and its background bass/treble adjustments no longer cause an audible flutter every few seconds.
